key_insight: UFLD combines reinforcement learning with conformal prediction to classify wafer defects while stopping inspection once sufficient information is acquired.
engineering_relevance: Adaptive acquisition could enable higher-throughput wafer inspection without full-surface scans or an additional learned confidence-estimation network.
method: Use reinforcement learning to adaptively select measurements.
Apply conformal prediction to quantify prediction uncertainty after each step.
Stop acquisition when sufficient information is available.
evidence_signal: On MixedWM38, the authors report about 40% lower acquisition time and 98.4% inspection accuracy, with comparisons against existing adaptive acquisition procedures and standard CNNs.
watch_item: Performance and uncertainty calibration under real production distribution shifts remain unestablished by the abstract.
paper_title: Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis: integrating reinforcement learning and conformal prediction for reliable wafer defect classification
